title: Four Shapes of the Same Care
logline: A mother's day moves between a toddler who needs feeding, a sick teenager who needs medicine, a young adult leaving for a first job, and a grown child on the phone from abroad who needs nothing from her at all.

object.note: Object 6 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: The patient attention given to a carved face becomes care given to living ones: a mother's single day moving between children who each need something different.

thread_out.thread: A mother's care leads to the bodies of those who carry: tea-leaf baskets coming off backs at the weighing shed, and relief visible in the body underneath.

requirements: A real family with children at genuinely different life stages, willing to be filmed over enough time
Full consent from every family member shown, including minors' guardians
No engineering of the household's circumstances to match the premise
